summary: security lens over quality-gate-baseline (16 product path(s), 982ed20..0da10ad, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 2 non-blocking. blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Do not accept story-scoped evidence for a task review (factory/scripts/forge_cli/review.py:489): The new fallback accepts `evidence_path(base, story, artifact)` without tying the artifact to `args.id`.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Parse all valid export whitespace when checking final FACTORY values (tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:197): `readCommands` recognizes only lines beginning with the exact string `export FACTORY_`.

[P2] Reject new ignore entries outside the pinned allowlist (tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:224): The guard hashes only ignore lines beginning with `backend/` or `contract/` and separately fixes the workflow entries, but it does not reject other exclusions.
